transcript.text: Hi — I'm MindWell. I can ask a few questions to understand how you're feeling. This is a prototype and not a diagnosis. For emergencies, contact local emergency services.
Can you briefly describe what's been bothering you recently? You can type freely.
I cannot able to sleep at night, I wold be awake all time at night
Thanks. I'll ask a few short questions about mood and anxiety. Please select the option that best matches how often you experienced each item in the last 2 weeks.
PHQ-9: 1) Little interest or pleasure in doing things
Nearly every day
PHQ-9: 2) Feeling down, depressed, or hopeless
Nearly every day
PHQ-9: 3) Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
Nearly every day
PHQ-9: 4) Feeling tired or having little energy
Nearly every day
PHQ-9: 5) Poor appetite or overeating
Nearly every day
PHQ-9: 6) Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
Nearly every day
PHQ-9: 7) Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
Nearly every day
PHQ-9: 8) Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed. Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving a lot more than usual
Nearly every day
PHQ-9: 9) Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way
Nearly every day
GAD-7: 1) Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
Nearly every day
GAD-7: 2) Not being able to stop or control worrying
Nearly every day

Nearly every day
GAD-7: 4) Trouble relaxing
Nearly every day

Nearly every day

Nearly every day

Nearly every day
